rationale: The stock gapped up 26% on strong earnings but has already reversed sharply from the session high of $178.55 down to $158.47, sitting at only 15% of today's range and well below VWAP ($166.05) and the 9-EMA ($160.59), indicating sustained selling pressure. The broad market is under severe stress (SPY -3.43%, VIXY +20.5%), which amplifies downside risk on any long while the stock's extreme intraday volatility (ATR ~$3.21 on 5m bars, spread 60+ bps, thin float of 33.78M) makes precise stop placement unreliable for a short as well. The risk/reward in either direction is unclear given the chaotic price action and hostile macro backdrop.
